testcase.name: the six-pack goal says out loud that abs are a body fat story
sets older than the window do not count
a lift already trained this week is not suggested back
every suggestion primarily works the muscle it is offered for
every muscle every goal asks for has lifts that train it
nothing logged is reported as nothing to read, not as failure
the width goal trains side delts far harder than upper traps
a set counts fully for what the lift is for and half for what it also works
a week of only pressing reports the width muscles as short
warm-ups are not stimulus and are not counted
